workflows.name: implement
workflows.description: Plan a goal, do the work, and review it, as pull requests

steps.text:
Read thread #{thread} of {channel} and this goal: {args.goal}
Complete this task with a short plan as its result: the files to change, and how to check the change works.

Do the change for this goal: {args.goal}
Read the plan task's result in {run} (mu tasks list {run} --state all, then mu read <id>), make the change, and complete this task with a one-line summary.

Review the change against the plan, for this goal: {args.goal}
Read the plan and the work task's result in {run} (mu tasks list {run} --state all, then mu read <id>). Complete this task with "approve", or with the changes needed.

workflows.name: review
workflows.description: Review one thread's change and say what you found

steps.text: Review the change discussed in thread #{thread} of {channel}. Read it with mu read {thread}, check the work, and complete this task with what you found.
